name: smwgraphics-crazy-castle
title: Crazy Castle 3 - Garden
description:
The foreground of the first 15 levels in Bugs Bunny: Crazy Castle 3.

Includes a total of 15 palettes, since the original game uses one palette per level.

Mod note: Make sure to use GFX header Rope1 if you want the animated platforms to function like the moving ropes. Edited the sample level to reflect this.
